name: Glyph Mosaic
tagline: Everything is made of tiny printed glyphs: they swarm, re-resolve and spiral into new forms.
description: A generative print system in motion: images, marks and words are built from a grid of small CMYK glyph tiles (rings, crosses, dots, pixel diamonds) on warm paper. The mosaic re-resolves between coarse and fine, glyphs re-pattern in waves, the field swirls into a radial vortex around a silhouette and the camera zooms through a single glyph into the next form. One continuous shot, no cuts.
bestFor: brand identities built on a mark or monogram
tech launches that want warmth, not neon

signature: re-resolve: the mosaic regrids coarse ↔ fine and the silhouette becomes a new shape, every glyph easing to its new cell
vortex bloom: the field around the form spirals outward into concentric rings and folds back in
glyph zoom: the camera pushes into one glyph until it fills the frame, its parts become the next mosaic

camera: Mostly locked off and flat. The only camera move is a slow scale: the field breathes in and out, and a seamless push into a single glyph (scale 1 → 20+) carries one form into the next.

texture.notes: Warm off-white paper with fine grain. Glyphs are flat process colours printed with multiply and a hair of misregistration (1–2 px offset of a cyan or magenta ring), so overlaps mix like ink.

lighting: None. Flat ink on paper; depth comes only from glyph size and density.
sound: Continuous and textural: a soft pulsing synth bed with granular ticks and chimes as glyphs flip; ripples and blooms ride swells rather than hits; no hard drops.

beats.label: Re-resolves into a bust, vortex blooms
Push into one glyph, it splits in four
Glyphs regrid back to the monogram

motionSummary: Moves like a living print: thousands of tiny glyphs re-pattern in waves, re-resolve into new shapes, spiral into a vortex and carry you through a single glyph into the next form.

composition: one centred form (a mark, a silhouette, a word) made of glyph tiles on a lot of empty paper
or a full-bleed field of glyph rings radiating around a negative-space silhouette
scale contrast: tiny dense glyphs at the core, big sparse glyphs at the edge
visual.shapeLanguage: a small kit of geometric glyphs on a grid: rings, dotted rings, plus and x crosses, 4- and 8-dot clusters, pixel diamonds, pie and fan segments; all round-ended and flat
visual.contrast: low-key paper with bright process colours (magenta, cyan, yellow, green) and black; colour clusters by region (cyan floor, magenta face, yellow edge light) like a halftone separation

grammar.pacing: continuous and fluid: one long transformation after another, 1–3 s each, with short 10–20 f holds where the form reads
grammar.rhythm: wave-driven: changes ripple across the grid from a point (centre or an edge) with a per-glyph stagger of 0.5–2 f, so the whole field shimmers
grammar.easing: smooth in-out for regrids and camera ([0.65,0,0.35,1]); soft spring for single glyphs popping or flipping; never linear, never bouncy on the whole field
grammar.acceleration: slow start, long glide, soft landing; the vortex accelerates outward then decelerates as it settles
movement: re-resolve: the grid pitch changes (coarse ↔ fine) and each glyph eases to its new cell
glyph flip: a tile swaps to another glyph in a wave
radial vortex: the field rotates and expands in concentric rings around the form
seamless push into a single glyph
breathing scale of the whole field (±4 %)
colour wave: process colours travel across the mosaic
grammar.density: high inside forms, near zero outside; the frame's emptiness is part of the look
grammar.holds: short (10–20 f) at each readable form, never dead: glyphs keep flickering subtly

transitionPresets.name: Re-resolve
transitionPresets.build: sample the next shape on the same grid; glyphs inside both shapes ease to their new cell (12–24 f, ease.morph), glyphs only in the old shape shrink to 0, new ones grow from 0, with a 0.5–1 f stagger by distance from the centre
transitionPresets.sound: a granular shimmer that rises and settles

transitionPresets.name: Vortex bloom
transitionPresets.build: the form re-resolves into the vortex: every glyph of the silhouette flies to its own slot on the inner polar rings (inner rings first, nearest angle, 0.5–1 f stagger by distance), while the outer rings bloom out from 0.2 to fill the frame and the whole field turns 30–60°; outer rings larger and sparser; to close, reverse it and the rings fold back into the form
transitionPresets.sound: a soft swell with a rising chime

transitionPresets.name: Glyph zoom
transitionPresets.build: pick one glyph at the form's focal point; scale the whole field up around it (×1 → ×25, ease.camera) until that glyph fills the frame; its parts (dots, arms, ring) separate into a small set that becomes the next composition
transitionPresets.sound: a whoosh that closes into a single bell tone

transitionPresets.name: Glyph wave
transitionPresets.build: every glyph flips to a different glyph or colour in a wave from one edge or from the centre, 1 f stagger per cell, each flip a 4 f scale-down/scale-up
transitionPresets.sound: a run of tiny ticks like rain on glass

transitionPresets.name: Split and scatter
transitionPresets.build: a single large glyph splits into 4–8 parts that slide apart on the grid (12 f) and each becomes a new glyph group; reversed, groups gather into one

archetypes.name: Glyph mark
archetypes.purpose: the brand mark, monogram or word built from glyphs
archetypes.composition: one centred form, 30–45 % of the frame height, on empty paper; colours by region
archetypes.elements: the mark sampled onto a fine glyph grid, a small mono caption below
archetypes.motion: glyphs pop in on a centre-out wave, then shimmer; a caption types on

archetypes.name: Glyph portrait
archetypes.purpose: a person, a product or an object as a mosaic
archetypes.composition: a centred silhouette (bust, device, object) in glyph tiles; tones by glyph density, colour by region
archetypes.elements: silhouette sampled from an image or SVG, 600–2,500 glyphs
archetypes.motion: regrids from coarse to fine as it resolves; colour waves pass across it

archetypes.name: Vortex field
archetypes.purpose: the big, immersive moment: energy, scale, many things at once
archetypes.composition: a full-bleed field of concentric glyph rings around a negative-space silhouette at the centre; glyphs grow toward the edge
archetypes.elements: polar rings of glyphs, a white silhouette cut-out, colour bands (cyan floor, magenta, yellow edge)
archetypes.motion: the rings rotate slowly, ripples travel outward, glyphs flip in waves

archetypes.name: Glyph hero
archetypes.purpose: one idea in one big symbol
archetypes.composition: a single large glyph in the centre (25–35 % of the frame), or a 2 × 2 set of glyphs
archetypes.elements: one glyph at hero size with visible print overlap (magenta ring, black pixel cross, cyan dots)
archetypes.motion: rotates a quarter turn, its ring colour cycles through the process colours, parts pulse

archetypes.name: Glyph caption
archetypes.purpose: the message and the call to action
archetypes.composition: a short word or line in the display face, or spelled in large glyph pixels, with a mono line below
archetypes.elements: display word, mono caption, a few loose glyphs as punctuation
archetypes.motion: letters assemble from glyphs on a wave; loose glyphs settle around

beats.motion: glyphs pop in centre-out and shimmer

beats.purpose: what it is: a person, product or object
beats.motion: the mark re-resolves into the portrait, coarse to fine
the field blooms out to full bleed and spirals
push into one glyph; it holds as a hero symbol
glyph groups gather into the caption, then the mark

sequence.cutRhythm: no cuts: one continuous shot; changes every 1–3 s carried by re-resolves, blooms and zooms; short 10–20 f holds on each readable form

scenes.action: the product's monogram builds from glyphs on a centre-out wave: magenta stem, yellow edge, cyan base; a mono caption 'made of everything' types below
the monogram regrids into a coarse bust, then resolves fine; a colour wave passes from cyan to magenta
the bust's glyphs spiral out and become the inner rings; outer rings bloom to full bleed, ripples run outward, glyphs flip in waves, the field turns 40°
push into one pixel-cross glyph at the heart until it fills the frame; its ring cycles magenta → cyan → green
the hero splits into four glyph groups that gather into the product name; the monogram settles beside it

elements.text: short; display face for one word or name, mono for captions; letters can be spelled in glyph pixels; type assembles from glyphs and dissolves back into them
elements.logo: sampled onto the glyph grid and built from tiles; at the end it may resolve to its true vector form for a beat
elements.icons: become hero glyphs: pure geometry in process colours, rotating and splitting
elements.images: never shown as photos: sampled into glyph portraits by brightness (density) and region (colour)
elements.ui: sparingly: a device silhouette made of glyphs, or a screen as a glyph grid with one live area
elements.shapes: the glyph kit only: rings, crosses, dots, pixel diamonds, segments
elements.background: warm paper, empty; the vortex field is the only full-bleed background
elements.particles: the glyphs are the particles: loose ones drift and settle, never sparks or dust

audio.sync: regrids and blooms start on a phrase and ride a swell; glyph waves follow hi-hat or granular runs; the glyph zoom lands on a bell or chord change
audio.sfx: granular shimmer for regrids, tiny ticks for glyph waves, soft swells and a rising chime for blooms, a single bell tone at the end of a glyph zoom
